sections.title: How the population has changed in Bury
sections.label: Select another local authority

sections.content: In 2024, Bury was the 18th largest local authority in the North West, with a population of almost 200,000. Its population increased by 1.1% compared with 2023, and has increased by 10.1% since 2001.

sections.title: Largest local authorities in the North West, 2001-2024
Population density in Bury
sections.content: In 2024, the population density in Bury was 2,000 people per square kilometre, which was more than the North West (548), and more than the United Kingdom as a whole (285).

sections.title: Densest local authorities in the North West, 2024
Median age in Bury
sections.content: In 2024, the median age in Bury was 40 years, which was older than the North West (39 years), and the same as the United Kingdom as a whole (40 years).
